## Qwen3 VL 235B API

Qwen3 VL 235B is a large language model by Alibaba Qwen, available on the Venice API as `qwen3-vl-235b-a22b`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Qwen3-VL 235B vision-language model with MoE architecture. The largest model in the Qwen3-VL series, with superior visual perception, OCR, and multimodal reasoning.

### Qwen3 VL 235B API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qwen3-vl-235b-a22b` | Standard | Private | $0.21 / $1.90 per 1M |

### Qwen3 VL 235B specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Alibaba Qwen |
| Released | Jan 16, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 128K tokens |
| Max output | 16K tokens |
| Served precision | FP8 |

### How to use the Qwen3 VL 235B API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "qwen3-vl-235b-a22b"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "qwen3-vl-235b-a22b",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
